name: m4-hk-fastpath-typer-kperf
description: Does binding the kind check in `TypeComparers.isSubType2` (`tp1.isHigherKinded || tp2.isHigherKinded`) and `TypeRef.relativize` remove their vtable stubs, and what does it buy on a typer-only compile of the scala corpus? In `m4-symfinal-typer-kperf`'s base profile, `NoArgsTypeRef.isHigherKinded` is 0.50% of cycles inclusive, 0.32% of it under `isSubType2`.
One fork per build and round, kperf cycles and instructions, JIT recorded over each whole fork for `jit_diff`. Patched JDK 26, `SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`.

variantDescriptions.hk: `pr208` plus (`8e39afc3a3`) final `TypeRef.isHigherKinded` with `NoArgsTypeRef.typeParams` inlined, a `TypeRef` type test before `isHigherKinded` in `isSubType2`, and `PolyType`/`ClassInfoType` cases before `rawInfo.typeParams` in `Symbol.typeParams`
